name: El Farol Bar problem
summary: A simultaneous congestion game where players choose to go to a bar and prefer to go only if fewer than 60% attend.
rules_text: Each game has N players. Simultaneously and without seeing others' choices, each player chooses either Go or Stay. After all choices, count G = number who chose Go. If G < 0.6 * N, the bar is not crowded: every player who chose Go gets payoff 1, every player who chose Stay gets 0. If G >= 0.6 * N, the bar is crowded: every player who chose Go gets 0, every player who chose Stay gets 1. In the one-shot version the game ends after this payoff. In the repeated version this round repeats for a fixed number of Thursdays with cumulative score.
rating_reason: Simultaneous threshold guessing, opponent modeling perfect fit
